events.title: Lovestruck on bike
events.location: City Hall Plaza, 1 City Hall Ave, Ste 500, Boston, MA
events.description:
Get ready to cry your heart out, stay delusional, and confess your feelings during our Valentines Day Weekend ride!!

Projected to be 40 degrees out, so a beautiful day to get out and bring a loved one (partner/friend/family/pet) on a main character bike ride through Boston along the Charles, into Cambridge’s romance-themed bookstore: Lovestruck Books and Cafe!!

FREE BLUEBIKE codes will be provided!! Bring a friend who doesn’t have a bike

Lovestruck has a George Howell cafe so well be book perusing, making friends, and enjoying their coffee & treats there :)
events.address: 1 City Hall Ave, Ste 500, Boston, MA

events.title: Jimmy’s Café: Spring 2026
events.description:
Happy 1-year anniversary to Jimmy's Café🩵

We have an extra special pop-up planned for May 2nd to celebrate the growth of what started as our little backyard home cafe🥰

We are so grateful for everyone's support and appreciation of the unique flavors and vibrant cultures we highlight in our menu - a passion that Jimmy and I share with all of you!

Because of this and the incredible contributions that Japanese influence has on cafe culture, and its distinctly nostalgic flavors, we decided to theme this year's spring menu:

「ジミーの春」

"Jimmy no Haru" or "Jimmy's Spring" is a take on the nostalgic Japanese film Kikujirō no Natsu, accompanied by the song Summer by Joe Hisaishi

In addition, we are collaborating with some folks in the community to bring extra special pastries from Phinista Cafe👀, a signature banger of a drink created with @samatchalee, and coordinating a special ride with Boston Cafe Bikers by opening our space to be inclusive to the biking community!

As always, we can't wait to see you there🫶

events.title: Jimmy’s Summer Café: Celebrate Philippines Independence
events.description:
You probably guessed it by now...

Kuya Jimmy travels to the PHILIPPINES🇵🇭🥥🌴

We are so excited to island hop to this beautiful country and we were so inspired by the incredible flavors and sweets that Filipinos enjoy! To celebrate, we are bringing the islands to you in a few weeks 🇵🇭🫶

Special shout out to Sarah’s Little Kitchen for proving time and time again she is a Filipina Force to be reckoned with when it comes to baking! As always, we will feature some of her amazing treats🤭

Thank you so so so much Kuya Eric for all of the menu inspo, knowledge, videography, tastings, and sincerity☀️

Soooo I guess we’ll see you there, suki?
